notes.title: The Executive – Patch Notes [1.3.2]
notes.content:
[p]📢 Dear Executives!

We're rolling out a small patch before our summer break, addressing issues you've helpfully brought to our attention on Discord.[/p][h3][b]🐞 BUGFIXES[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Localization Key Issues:[/b] Resolved missing localization keys, particularly for new players experiencing telemetry-related text omissions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Missing CJK Characters:[/b] Fixed an issue where some Korean, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese characters were appearing as squares (🗌). This has been corrected, and their respective affinities are now as intended.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]🎥 See you on the red carpet,

notes.title: The Executive – Patch Notes [1.3.1]
notes.content:
[p]📢 Dear Executives!

We hope you’ve been enjoying the new features we rolled out over the weekend.[/p][p]Some of you reported a bug affecting film revenue calculations, introduced in the latest patch. This is a minor update, focused on addressing that issue as quickly as possible.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]🐞 HOTFIX[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Movie Financials Bug: [/b]When playing with an uncapped framerate and a fast computer, film financials could behave incorrectly if the framerate was too high. While we couldn’t precisely pinpoint the root cause, the issue appears to stem from the in-game time management system, which struggles with certain calculations when frame durations are too short. As a quick fix, we’ve decided to remove the uncapped FPS option.[/p][/*][/list][p]Our sincere apologies if you were impacted by this bug![/p][p]🎥 See you on the red carpet,
 — [b]The Dev Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: The Executive – Metasave, Sell IPs, BO rankings! – Patch Notes [1.3.0]
notes.content:
[p][b]📢 Dear Executives![/b]

Thank you for your ongoing support, feedback, and brilliant suggestions. Patch 1.3.0 brings [b]three of the most requested features[/b] from our Discord community — plus a round of key fixes and improvements.[/p][p]  [/p][h3][b]🆕 NEW FEATURES[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]🔍 Insights Metasave
[/b]Your discovered insights are now saved in a [i]metasave[/i]. When starting a new game, you can choose whether to carry over knowledge unlocked from previous playthroughs — or go in blind.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]💰Sell Your IPs
[/b]Need a cash injection? You can now sell intellectual properties you’ve created or acquired, opening up fresh strategies for making money.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]🥇 Box Office Rankings
[/b]To boost immersion and the competitive spirit, we’ve added a new screen where you can compare your movie’s box office against others released the same month.
 ➡ [i]Note: This feature is partially backwards compatible.[/i] Older movies will show a regenerated competitor list since we weren’t previously saving that data. Rankings for these films may not reflect their original competitive landscape.  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]🐞 BUG FIX AND IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Premium Feature Score: [/b]The bonus was correctly affecting box office numbers, but the letter grade in the performance screen was stuck on ‘C’. It now properly reflects your actual performance.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Framerate Time Bug: [/b]On uncapped framerates, time could behave erratically or even freeze. This has been fixed — time now ticks forward as it should.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Box Office Spoiler Fix: [/b]Previously, you could see final box office numbers too early via the [i]My Movies[/i] section. That loophole is now closed.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Localization & UI: [/b]Minor localization updates and UI tweaks for a smoother experience.  
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🛠️ MODDING COMMUNITY SHOUTOUT[/b][/h3][p]To our incredible modding community:
Thank you for the real logos, real talent names, real IPs, real posters (yes, even all 7,000 of them), new themes, genres, balancing tweaks, and more.🥳[/p][p]You're absolute legends👏 We can't wait to see what you build next![/p][p]
  🎥 [b]See you on the red carpet![/b]  [/p][p][b]The Dev Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: The Executive – Steam Workshop! – Patch Notes [1.2.1]
notes.content:
[b]📢 Dear Executives![/b]

Thank you for your continued support and patience. We're excited to roll out the long-awaited [b]Steam Workshop integration[/b]! This update also brings a handful of additional improvements—including the highly requested [b]Sandbox Mode[/b].

[h3][b]🆕 NEW CONTENT[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Sandbox mode[/b]: A new difficulty option has been added. Enjoy infinite money, all themes unlocked from the start, plenty of research points, and no objective to guide your progression.
[/list]
[h3][b]⚖️ BALANCING CHANGES[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]No more shiny candidate[/b]: Overpowered recruits showing up in low-tier recruiting campaigns were breaking the game’s progression. These have been removed.
[*] [b]Updated IP Stats[/b]: Some IPs had genre and theme combinations with poor affinity. These have been adjusted to improve their viability.
[/list]
[h3][b]🐞 BUG FIX AND IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Employee Assignment Reset Fix[/b]: Assignments were sometimes not properly reset when returning to the main menu and starting/loading a game. This has been fixed.
[*] [b]Improved Box Office Performance Feedback[/b]: Each category now receives a more granular score, ranging from F to A.
[*] [b]Sandbox Mode Objective Fix[/b]: Previously, players were getting stuck on the “Unlock a new theme” objective while in Sandbox Mode on the experimental branch. Objectives have now been fully disabled in Sandbox Mode. Additionally, if you saved a Sandbox game prior to this fix, your progress will be automatically updated to clear the objective.
[*] [b]IP Name Display in Adaptation[/b]: Fixed an issue where the name of an acquired IP was not displaying correctly when starting an adaptation. It now shows as intended.
[*] [b]Various localization Fix[/b]

[/list]
[h3][b]🛠️ MODDING SUPPORT[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Steam Workshop[/b]: Upload and subscribe to mods directly via the Steam Workshop.
[*] [b]In Game Mod Selection[/b]: Enable or disable subscribed or custom mods directly in-game.
[*] [b]Moddable Data[/b]: The game’s JSON files can now be edited. You can for example:
[list]
[*] Add new industries
[*] Update/add content (genres, themes, ratings, IPs, talents, awards, events, distributors, competing movies, etc.)
[*] Update gameplay calculations (Box Office, Audience and Critic reviews, etc.)
[/list]
[*] [b]Moddable Visuals[/b]: We've externalized visual assets. You can:
[list]
[*] Update/add sprites for themes, genres, awards, and seasonal events
[*] Add posters to competing movies and IPs
[*] Add logos to distributors
[/list]
[*] [b]Documentation[/b]: Readme files in the build, [url=https://aniki-games.github.io/the-executive/INDEX.html]online documentation[/url], and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=2315430&browsesort=trend&section=readytouseitems]published example mods[/url] will help you get started
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022612/11da8592981a6bdecb0ffc88bfd1b41c3837642d.png[/img]

Thanks again for your continued support. We can’t wait to see the amazing mods you create to help improve [b]The Executive[/b]!

🎥 [b]See you on the red carpet![/b]

[b]The Dev Team[/b]

notes.title: The Executive – Patch Notes [1.1.1]
notes.content:
📢 Dear Executives!

We hope you're having a fantastic time licensing your favorite IPs and turning them into blockbuster films! Today's update is a small but important hotfix to smooth out a few issues before the weekend.

[h3][b]🔧 BUG FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Book Value Stuck at 0[/b] – A previous patch unintentionally caused studio book values to remain at 0. We've fixed this issue, and book values will now be calculated correctly. This means you can take on larger loans when necessary, and your final scoring will properly reflect your studio's financial worth.
[*] [b]Localization Improvements[/b] – Various text fixes and refinements for a better experience across all supported languages.
[/list]

notes.title: The Executive – IP Marketplace! – Patch Notes [1.1.0]
notes.content:
📢 [b]Attention, Executives![/b]

Today's update is a big one! We’re introducing the [b]IP Marketplace[/b], a brand-new feature that expands your creative empire. Plus, we’ve fixed several key bugs and improved overall gameplay. Let's dive in!

[h3][b]🆕 NEW FEATURE: IP MARKETPLACE[/b][/h3]
Building your own franchise is thrilling, but now, you can take it a step further! With the IP Marketplace, you can acquire the rights to iconic (spoofed) novels, TV shows, video games, and more—transforming them into blockbuster movie franchises.
[list]
[*] [b]Discover 700+ spoofed IPs[/b] inspired by renowned cultural franchises.
[*] [b]Explore 6 different media sources[/b]: Cartoons, Graphic Novels, Manga/Anime, Novels, TV Shows, and Video Games.
[*] [b]Invest in powerful new IPs[/b] – with a catch! The most valuable IPs come with tough conditions. Fail three times, and you lose the IP.
[/list]
[h3][b]🐞 BUG FIXES[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Movies Stuck in 'Wait for Release':[/b] Last week, we fixed an issue where distribution postponements could prevent you from completing movies or cause them to disappear. However some players still had corrupted movies in their save from before the previous patch. This update repairs affected save files, allowing you to resume distribution.
[*] [b]Achievement Unlock Fix:[/b] Some players experienced issues unlocking achievements due to a sync problem between save files and the Steam achievement system. Now, every time you load a game, we’ll automatically check and sync your achievements to ensure nothing is missed.
[*] [b]Home Entertainment Deal List UI:[/b] The UI displaying available deals was truncated—this has been fixed for better clarity.
[*] [b]Video Game Theme Affinities:[/b] Fixed an issue where genre-theme affinities were not working correctly for the Video Game theme.
[*] [b]Financials Date Fix:[/b] No more starting your financial records in 1969 while the journey begins in 1970.
[/list]
[h3][b]🔧 QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Slimmer Task UI[/b] to reduce scrolling when you have multiple movie productions at once.
[*] [b]Clearer feedback on franchise movie size restrictions[/b] in pre-production.
[/list]
[h3][b]🛣️ SHORT-TERM ROADMAP[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Distribution Postpone:[/b] Done ✅
[*] [b]IP Marketplace:[/b] Done ✅
[*] [b]More incidents:[/b] Localization in progress
[*] [b]Modding Support:[/b] In progress
[/list]
Thank you for your continued support! Your feedback is invaluable, and we’re committed to making The Executive even better. Keep sharing your thoughts, and we’ll keep improving!

🎥 See you on the red carpet! ✨
[b]The Dev Team[/b]

notes.title: The Executive – Patch Notes [1.0.9]
notes.content:
📢 Dear Executives!

Today’s update is smaller than planned, as one of our team members was under the weather this week. Unfortunately, this means we have to postpone the IP Marketplace release to next week. We truly wanted to launch it in time for the weekend, but we feel it still needs some quality-of-life improvements to be fully ready. We appreciate your patience and promise it’ll be worth the wait!

[h3][b]🔧 BUG FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Resuming a movie distribution could lock another movie[/b]: Previously, resuming a movie’s distribution while another movie was in production could prevent you from finishing the latter. This issue has now been fixed.
[*] [b]Disappearing movies[/b]: If you opened a window during the exact same frame that another movie production window appeared automatically, closing the first window would close both—leaving the movie in limbo. We fixed it!
[*] [b]Firing employees mid-task[/b]: It was possible to fire an employee while they were actively working on a task. This is no longer allowed. Now, employees can only be fired if they are idling or working on a passive task.
[*] [b]Achievements triggering too early[/b]: Achievements tied to box office milestones were unlocking too soon, spoiling the surprise. This has been fixed!
[*] [b]Missing Movie Titles[/b]: a dozen of movie titles were missing in the competitors’ movies database. They are now present.
[/list]
[h3][b]🛣️ SHORT-TERM ROADMAP UPDATE[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Coming Next Week (For Sure This Time!)
 ✅ More Production Incidents
 ✅ IP Marketplace
[*] In Progress
 🛠 Modding Support
[/list]
Thank you for your continued support—your feedback means everything to us! Keep sharing your thoughts, and we’ll keep improving The Executive! 🎬✨

[b]The Dev Team[/b]

notes.title: The Executive – Postpone Distribution! – Patch Notes [1.0.8]
notes.content:
📢 Attention, Executives!

Today’s update brings in a much demanded quality-of-life improvement!

[h3][b]🎥 QUALITY OF LIFE ENHANCEMENTS[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Postpone distribution type selection[/b]: many of you were frustrated you had to settle for a downgraded distribution type if the required staff for your preferred option wasn’t available. Now, you can postpone this decision, giving you the flexibility to wait until your ideal team members are ready to contribute to your cinematic masterpiece!
[/list]
[h3][b]⚖️ BUG FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Incident Localization fix[/b]: the description and options of one of the production incidents were KO. We fixed it.
[*] [b]Save File Optimization[/b]: We’ve improved how accounting line items are saved, significantly reducing save file sizes and ensuring smoother performance in extra-long Endless Mode games. This update is fully compatible with existing saves.
[/list]
[h3][b]🛣️ SHORT-TERM ROADMAP[/b][/h3]
Here is an update on our short-term roadmap:
[list]
[*] [b]Postpone Distribution Choice[/b]: DONE ✅
[*] [b]More Production Incidents[/b]: Coming Next Week!
[*] [b]IP Marketplace[/b]: Coming Next Week!
[*] [b]Modding Support[/b]: In progress
[/list]
Thank you for your ongoing support—we love hearing your feedback! 🎬✨

[b]The Dev Team[/b]

notes.title: The Executive – Patch Notes [1.0.7]
notes.content:
📢 Attention, Executives!

Today’s update focuses on bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements to enhance your experience with our short term plans at the end of the patch note.

[h3][b]🔧 BUG FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Endless Mode Talent Pool[/b]: Previously, the available talent pool remained static, making selections feel repetitive. It now reshuffles regularly, keeping things fresh.
[*][b]Incident Windows[/b]: Incident windows could be skipped during their opening animation, causing players to miss crucial details if they clicked on HUD buttons at the wrong time. This has been fixed.
[*][b]Endgame Scoring Fix[/b]: Cult and classic movies are now correctly factored into the final score calculation.
[*][b]Minor Animation Adjustments[/b]
[/list]
[h3][b]✨ QUALITY OF LIFE ENHANCEMENTS:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Cult & Classic Movies[/b]: Previously, players were only notified when a film achieved cult or classic status via a standard notification—too easy to miss! To give these moments the celebration they deserve, we now display a special window (with a fun cultural nod included).
[/list]
[h3][b]🛣️ SHORT-TERM ROADMAP[/b][/h3]
With (hopefully) the biggest bugs behind us, we’re now shifting our focus to major gameplay and content updates:
[list]
[*][b]Delayed Distribution Choice[/b] – You’ll soon be able to postpone selecting your film’s distribution type, giving you the flexibility to wait for the right employees to become available.
[*][b]More Production Incidents[/b] – We’re adding new incidents to ensure each playthrough feels unique and fresh.
[*][b]IP Marketplace[/b] – Building your own franchise is exciting, but what if you could acquire rights to your favorite books, video games, or mangas and turn them into blockbuster movie franchises?
[/list]We’re reviewing your feedback and suggestions to determine our next priorities.

[h3][b]🛠️ MODDING SUPPORT[/b][/h3]
From the very beginning, we aimed to make the game fully moddable, and we’re now ready to bring that vision to life. 
[list]
[*] Our first step will be enabling support for multiple mods from a dedicated folder. 
[*] Followed by externalizing more game data and assets. 
[*] Ultimately, we plan full Steam Workshop integration with easy-to-use modding tools.
[/list]
Thank you again for your patience and your support, while we work hard to give you the great experience you deserve playing [i]The Executive[/i].

[b]The Dev Team[/b]

notes.title: The Executive – Patch Notes [1.0.6]
notes.content:
📢 Dear Executives!

Today’s update focuses on mainly bug fixes, quality-of-life improvements, and balancing tweaks based on your feedback. Let’s dive in!

[h3][b]🔧 BUG FIX:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Potential Softlock Fix[/b] – Resolved an issue where opening multiple UI screens in the same frame could cause a softlock, preventing interaction.
[*][b]Starting Loan Repayment[/b] – Paying off your loan early? Now, you’ll only be debited the remaining balance instead of the full loan amount.
[*][b]Premium Features Accounting Error[/b] – Premium features selected during production planning step were mistakenly charged twice—this has been fixed.
[*][b]Provisional Budget Estimate[/b] – Premium features are now accurately included in the film’s provisional budget at every production step.
[*][b]Box Office Performance Screen Fix[/b] – The clapperboard display now correctly includes premium feature costs in the final budget.
[*][b]Third-Party Distributor Duplication[/b] – Fixed a rare issue where players could receive duplicate deals from the same distributor.
[*][b]Achievement Fixes[/b] – Three achievements (Hit Film, Big Budget, and Marketing Guru) were previously unobtainable—they should now unlock correctly.
[/list]
[h3][b]✨ QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Box Office Results UI[/b] – We understand that seeing post-theatrical losses highlighted in bright red was frustrating, especially since relying on ancillary revenue for profitability is standard once you're past the early game. To provide clearer feedback on your film’s performance and ensure you don’t feel discouraged, we've added more granularity to the visuals. The color coding now aligns with other parts of the game, showing how much of your total spending (movie budget + marketing) still needs to be recouped. We hope this more positive presentation helps you better assess your Box Office performance!
[/list]
[h3][b]⚖️ BALANCING:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]A [i]Twilight fan[/i] pointed out that Romance + Vampire was incorrectly considered a bad combo. They were right—this has been adjusted to reflect a more accurate synergy. 🧛❤️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022612/3042b06fff0f5946fba65ffb93355ada9890c95e.png[/img]
[/list]
Thank you for your continued support—we love hearing your feedback! 🎬✨

[b]The Dev Team[/b]

notes.title: The Executive – Autosave! – Patch Notes [1.0.5]
notes.content:
📢 Dear Executives!

We hope you're having a fantastic Tuesday. On our end, we’ve been hard at work and are excited to bring you a much-requested feature.

📜 Today's Update:

[h3][b]💾 AUTOSAVE![/b][/h3]

You asked, we listened! Auto-save is now available. At the end of each in-game year, your progress will be automatically saved, alternating between two dedicated slots to ensure extra security. No more lost progress—just smooth, uninterrupted decision-making!

[h3]⚖️ BUG FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
[list]
[*]Resolved an issue where 3 themes (Aliens, Teenagers, Slasher) were not properly configured, affecting talent affinity calculations. Now, you can cast the perfect talent lineup to bring your slasher horror vision to life![/list]

[h3]🚀 COMING SOON[/h3]

We’ve got some exciting updates on the horizon. Cough cough—did someone say Steam Workshop support? Stay tuned for more details soon!

Thank you for your continued support—we love hearing your feedback! 🎬✨

[b]The Dev Team[/b]

notes.title: The Executive - Patch notes [1.0.4]
notes.content:
📢 Dear Executives!

After a short break this weekend, we're back at it—working hard to improve The Executive!

Here is today’s patch content: 

[h3][b]🔧 BUG FIX:[/b][/h3]

[*] Ambient sounds will no longer stop after a while.

[h3][b]✨ QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS:[/b][/h3]

[*]New "View Trends" Button added to both the 3rd-party distributor selection screen and the self-distribution calendar for easier access.
[*]Improved Visual Feedback for the Premium Feature mechanic in the budget allocation screen. We realized this mechanic wasn’t as clear as it should be—this update brings it in the right direction, though there’s still more room for improvement.
[*]Franchise Creation Clarity: Updated tooltips to better explain the difference between IP and Franchise.

[h3][b]⚖️ BALANCING:[/b][/h3]

[*]Increased RP gain for Small and Medium movies, making it easier to spend a bit early on if you’re eager to jump into bigger productions.
[*]Reduced Employee Quit Rate and increased the cooldown between demands from the same employee to 2 years, giving you more control over team management.

[h3][b]🚀 COMING SOON:[/b][/h3]
[b]Thanks to your feedback, Autosave is actively in development and will be arriving very soon![/b]

Thank you again for your patience and your support, while we work hard to give you the great experience you deserve playing [i]The Executive[/i].

[b]The Dev Team[/b]

notes.title: The Executive – Endless Mode! – Patch Notes [1.0.3]
notes.content:

notes.title: The Executive - Patch notes [1.0.2]
notes.content:
Dear Movie Executives, 
Thanks again to everyone who submitted bug reports on our Discord and shared their logs and saves with us. It helped us tremendously.

Here is today’s patch content: 

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Bug with proposed release date[/b]: 
In some rare occasions, players were able to select a release date before the end of the post production, which would leave the movie in a non released state forever. The issue has been fixed
[*][b] Bug with Self Marketing sometimes corrupting the game[/b]:

It should be more obvious now that they are the best choice.
[/list]
PS: The endless mode still needs a bit more cooking but rest assured that we are committed to deliver it to you as soon as possible 
Thank you again for your patience and your support, while we work hard to give you the great experience you deserve playing The Executive.

[b]The Dev Team[/b]

notes.title: The Executive – Patch Notes [1.0.1]
notes.content:
[b]Dear Players,[/b]

First and foremost, we want to extend a heartfelt apology to everyone who experienced issues with cloud saves. We are gamers ourselves, so we fully understand how frustrating and disheartening it can be to lose progress after investing hours into the game. We have taken this issue very seriously, and after extensive investigation, we can now confidently say that [b]the cloud save issue should be resolved.[/b]

This launch has been rougher than expected, and we [b]deeply appreciate your patience and support[/b] as we worked to address these issues. Your time and dedication to The Executive mean the world to us, and we’re committed to ensuring the best experience possible moving forward.

[h3]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Cloud Save – Cloud saves are now working properly, preventing loss of progress.
[*] Cash Display – Fixed a bug that caused cash values to be missing on non-standard resolutions.
[*] Large Office Unlock – Resolved an issue that prevented the large office from being unlocked.
[*] Endgame Reel – Resolved the issue that locked the timeline when a player had too many highlights within a year
[*] Endgame Reel – Fixed a bug that prevented the classic and cult movies icons from being properly displayed in the timeline
[*] Endgame Reel – Improved the timeline flow for a smoother experience.
[*] Staff "Ecstatic" icon – Fixed a bug that prevented the icon from being properly displayed
[*] Asian Fonts – The texts should now be properly displayed in the research window when running the game in Korean, Chinese or Japanese
[*] Ancillaries – Avocado and soda scores were swapped in ancillary movie items
[/list]
[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*] Training RP Cost per month: Some players missed that training employee drains RP every month and were struggling to gain RP. Until we improve the UX to make it clearer, we significantly reduced the training RP costs.
[*] Loans: 2 loans options are now available during bankruptcy at every difficulty levels.
[/list]
[h3]Visual Tweaks[/h3]
[list]
[*] Billions abbreviation updated to G instead of B
[*] Fixed the couple genre icon missing in competitors movies
[*] ... And more to come!
[/list]
[h3]Quality-of-Life[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a warning to notify players when the game is nearing its conclusion... (Good news: we're hard at work on the highly requested Endless Mode. Stay tuned—it’s coming soon!)
[/list]
[h2]Endless Mode – We Hear You![/h2]
We’ve also heard loud and clear the overwhelming demand for an [b]Endless Mode[/b]—and we’re excited to say that we’re [b]all hands on deck[/b] to make it happen as soon as possible! Stay tuned for updates, as we can’t wait to bring this much-requested feature to life.
Thank you for being part of [i]The Executive[/i]. Your passion and feedback drive us forward, and we’re excited for what’s ahead!

[b]The Development Team[/b]

notes.title: Post-release follow up
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thomas here, we'd like to communicate with you about the launch itself, and more importantly what's to expect from now on!

Firstly, we of course want to thank you all about your interest in the game. You've been a lot of people making your own movies and hitting the top of the charts! You've been a lot to leave kind words about the game and it is really heartwarming, so thank you again

Now, we also know that there's been things that are bothering you, or that you would want to be added to the game, and I wanted to update you on this. Note that this is about short term, and that we'll communicate later on further things that will come for The Executive. So here we go!

[h3]Broken saves[/h3]
Some of you have reported broken saves. [b]This is now fixed and should not require you to update the game[/b]. Just to be sure, if you opened Steam before 1pm CET, you can reboot Steam. As the fix was a change to Steam configuration for our game, it might be necessary
The be a bit more transparent with you, our Cloud save system was limited in size, and this limit was set too low, making the save system weird/not working at all past this limit.
We've now increased this limit to a point that I'd be very surprise you reach (that is the maximum authorized by the way, so please don't take that as a challenge :D)

We know this  is a pretty big issue and that save issues are the most frustrating ones, so we want to deeply apologize for this. During our tests, we restart a lot of saves and thus had most of the time pretty light (or at least, light enough) saves for this not to happen during the tests. 
Once again, we're sorry about this, and this should now be fixed

[h3]Money not being displayed[/h3]
This will require a smallest amount of word ; there's an issue with the money not being correctly displayed on bigger screens. We've foudn the issue and this will be fixed in the next patch, that should be coming very soon. We'll keep you posted!

[h3]Other bugs[/h3]
We're also aware of other bugs that you've reported on the forums or by mail -thanks again for this!- and we're working on it. Some of them (as much as possible!) might also be in the first patch, but since we're still investigating, I'd rather not make any promise ; you'll be able to check what's been fixed in the patchnote coming with the update. For exemple the end game screen getting frozen on the first years of the summary is also getting investigated as we speak, we'll do our best to plug the fix in the patch!

[h3]Speaking of End Game[/h3]
This is the last thing we wanted to communicate ; we've seen all your feedback (I do think it is the main feedback about the game) about the ending being abrupt, and a bit deceiptive
[u][b]We'll be adding an endless mode to The Executive![/b][/u]
Now as you might guess, adding this kind of feature does take time, as it wasn't really planned. I won't give you any specific date as a lot of things can happen when you're developping things, but I still want to give you a general idea.
So while this is subject to change, we'd love to have it out in a couple of weeks. After fixing the nasty bugs that remains, it's going to be the top priority! 

Also, in case you want to communicate more directly with the dev team, know that there's a [url=https://discord.gg/jnU36gaQvY]Discord server for the game[/url]!
From me and the whole dev team, thanks again for all your feedback, and for playing The Executive!

notes.title: Demo Update for The Executive
notes.content:
We’re excited to bring you our latest demo update for The Executive - A Movie Industry Tycoon! 
Based on your invaluable feedback, we’ve implemented several significant changes and enhancements to improve your gaming experience. Here’s what’s new:

[h3]Gameplay Enhancements[/h3]

[list][*] [b]Slower Game Pace[/b]: We've listened to your feedback regarding game speed. The overall pace of the game has been adjusted to provide a more relaxed and strategic gameplay experience, allowing you to focus on building your movie empire without feeling rushed.
[*] [b]New Decade Playthrough[/b]: Explore the vibrant world of 1990s cinema! Our new playthrough option focuses on this iconic decade, featuring era-specific talents, films, and cultural references that will immerse you in the essence of 90s filmmaking.[/list]

[h3]System Overhauls[/h3]

[list][*] [b]Reworked Talents Stats System[/b]: We’ve completely revamped the talents stats system to provide a more nuanced and engaging experience. Players can now make more exciting decisions when casting your movies.
[*] [b]Reworked Staffing System[/b]: The staffing system has undergone a significant redesign, making it more engaging to assemble your team. Employees now have distincts skills so you will have to optimize your hiring to ensure that you can have the perfect blend of talent for your projects.[/list]

[h3]New Features[/h3]

[list][*] [b]Save System[/b]: You can now save your game progress… and load them! ;-) 
It was about time… 
[*] [b]Explore the Chinese Movie Industry[/b]: Expand your horizons with the new option to switch to the Chinese movie industry. Experience unique challenges and opportunities that come with this vibrant market, adding a fresh dimension to your gameplay.[/list]

[h3]Additional Improvements[/h3]

[list][*] Various bug fixes and performance optimizations.
[*] Improved UI elements for better navigation and usability.
[*] Prettier Offices.
[*] Expanded tutorial elements to assist new players in understanding game mechanics.[/list]

We hope these updates enhance your experience in The Executive! As always, your feedback is invaluable to us, and [url=https://discord.gg/cuKMbj4Yhz]we look forward to hearing your thoughts[/url] on these new features. Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to develop and refine the game!

Note that, for those who already had the previous demo installed, you might have to uninstall the demo and reinstall the demo for it to work properly.

Happy filming!
